title: The face of a soil bank after 8,000 frames of ants — worked, or just slumped
question: Ants now tamp the wall of every cell they dig, so a burrow stands instead of closing in five frames. Does the worked bank read as *dug* — benches, an overhang, holes at the toe — or does it just read as a mess? Second question, and the one I would change on your word: I made the packed wall darker than loose soil, so the tunnels inside the bank are invisible (both columns look identical from further out). A pale wall, like the nest material, would make a nest read from across the map. Darker, paler, or leave it?
context_md: Same colony, same seed, same binary; the only difference is one switch that turns the tamping off. Four stops top to bottom: frames 0, 500, 2000, 8000, held at noon, 10x on the face the colony works. Discrete events after 8,000 frames — with tamping: 278 digs, 384 wall cells packed, 130 roofed tunnel cells still standing. Without: 610 digs, 0 packed, 0 roofed. Supersedes card 20260830T181245204Z-ba7326, which was cropped too wide to see anything.
